stable.label: matter-lab-0.6-integrated
stable.note: Matter Lab 0.6 remains the integrated baseline. The Materials Lab work is isolated on genesis-materials-0.1 and has not been promoted. Overall product remains unverified because live GitHub.io and real iPhone Safari have not been independently exercised.

lab.original_intent: Make the graphics high quality and make sand actually read and behave like sand: very fine visible granular detail, piles, structures, wet sand, water, and a GPU path that can later grow toward lava, clouds and creatures.
lab.bounded_objective: Prove one reusable high-detail material-sandbox architecture: deterministic coarse sand/water simulation truth in a Worker, moisture-dependent wet-sand cohesion, touch interaction, adaptive grid quality, WebGPU state-derived rendering and Canvas fallback, without regressing Matter Lab 0.6.
acceptance_criteria: same-seed CPU material fixture reproduces the same state hash
suspended sand falls and stepping conserves sand/rock counts
water descends and stepping conserves water count
water contact produces explicit wet-sand moisture state
wet cohesive sand retains a taller fixture than equivalent dry sand
Materials Lab browser assets pass syntax/static checks
old Matter Lab 0.6 model regression test remains PASS
full pull-request GitHub Actions run passes on the exact candidate head before merge

ci.simulation_test: PASS genesis matter 0.6 cooperative self-assembly tests

capabilities: reversible association between unlike generic species
explicit forward and reverse toy reaction events
internal transformed particle state on reacted associations
tagged cooperative and closure assembly edges

active_objective: Finish and independently test GENESIS Materials Lab 0.1 as a reusable sand/water visual-material candidate without changing Stable.
next_gate: Wire the playable Materials Lab into CI, run both new materials fixtures and old Matter Lab 0.6 regressions on a pull request, inspect exact logs, repair only causal failures, and merge only on full PASS.
invariants: ChatGPT cannot self-certify its own changes
No critical project fact may live only in chat memory
Prototype experiments do not become product without a productionization gate
Tyler is not the build system or log courier
UNKNOWN must never silently become PASS
Infrastructure must not be described as simulation capability
CI PASS does not imply live deployment PASS or iPhone PASS
Rendering consumes simulation state and must not secretly become simulation logic
WebGPU rendering does not imply GPU-compute physics
Coarse sand cells must not be described as literal micron-scale grains
Toy moisture cohesion must not be described as validated capillary/geotechnical physics
Water local-move rules must not be described as Navier-Stokes or SPH
Matter Lab 0.6 remains recoverable while Materials Lab is experimental
